parameters.name: Asc
parameters.description:
The sorting order of data records in the response. Valid values:

- **0**: descending order.
- **1**: ascending order.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The name of the device.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the data records to query. The value must be greater than the start time specified by **StartTime**. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1579249499000.

parameters.name: Identifier
parameters.description: The field identifier in the stored hot data. This is the field identifier in the **Items** request parameter used when calling the **WriteDevicesHotStorageData** operation to write hot data.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The device ID.
><notice> **IotId** is a globally unique identifier for the device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

parameters.name: NextPageToken
parameters.description: The token for the next page. If a next page exists, the service returns this token. Include this token in the next request to retrieve the next page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of data records that can be returned for a single field identifier. Maximum value: 100.

The number of data records returned for any field does not exceed this value.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the data records to query. The value must be less than the end time specified by **EndTime**. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1579249499000.

parameters.name: UserTopic
parameters.description:
The custom topic to which the data you want to query belongs. Enter all categories after the `user` category of the custom topic.

For more information about custom topics, see [Custom topics](~~85539~~).
